monster.name: Heliox Security Construct
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Door-Warden
entries: The Heliox Security Construct has advantage on attack rolls against creatures attempting to move through a doorway, hatch, or passage 5 feet wide or narrower.

trait.name: Brace for Impact
entries: The Heliox Security Construct has advantage on saving throws against being pushed or knocked prone while aboard a moving vehicle.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Heliox Security Construct makes one Glaive attack and one Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

action.name: Hold the Line (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Until the start of the Heliox Security Construct's next turn, it and allied constructs within 10 feet gain a +2 bonus to AC, and opportunity attacks made by those allies have advantage.

reaction.name: Intercept
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the Heliox Security Construct would move past it, the construct makes one Shield Bash attack against that creature.

trait.name: Heat-Sink Plating
entries: When the forge-hammer takes fire damage, it reduces the damage by 5 (to a minimum of 0).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The forge-hammer makes two Hammer attacks.

action.name: Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Anvil Lock (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature the forge-hammer can see within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The forge-hammer can grapple only one creature at a time.

monster.name: Heliox Engine Overseer
languages: understands Common, Elvish, and Modron but can't speak
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Overclock Authority
entries: While within 10 feet of a linked engine or control panel, the Heliox Engine Overseer can use a bonus action to gain 10 temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, it has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

trait.name: Damage Threshold Handler
entries: If the Heliox Engine Overseer is conscious and actively operating a mobile fortress engine console, that fortress's damage threshold increases by 5.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Heliox Engine Overseer makes two Arcane Arc attacks.

action.name: Arcane Arc
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) lightning damage.

action.name: Shock Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the overseer's choice within 20 feet must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Emergency Repairs (1/Day)
entries: While at an engine panel, the Heliox Engine Overseer restores 30 hit points to one construct vehicle subsystem or linked mechanical installation.

monster.name: Heliox Crystal Technician
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Volatile Cargo
entries: When the Heliox Crystal Technician drops to 0 hit points, crystalline shrapnel bursts from its body. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Heliox Crystal Technician makes two Shard Knife attacks, or one Shard Knife attack and uses Crystal Scatter.

action.name: Shard Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Crystal Scatter
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature that fails also has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

monster.name: Heliox Harpoon Gunner
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Roof Stabilizers
entries: The Heliox Harpoon Gunner has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that would knock it prone or push it while it is on a vehicle roof or exterior catwalk.

trait.name: Pinpoint Targeting
entries: The Heliox Harpoon Gunner ignores half cover.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Heliox Harpoon Gunner makes two Bolt Repeater attacks, or one Bolt Repeater attack and one Hookshot attack.

action.name: Bolt Repeater
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hookshot
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the gunner.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The runebinder doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Runebinder Spellcasting
entries: The Heliox runebinder is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components.
At will: {@spell ray of frost}, {@spell fire bolt}, {@spell shield}
3/day each: {@spell counterspell}, {@spell scorching ray}, {@spell web}
1/day each: {@spell fireball}, {@spell ice storm}

trait.name: Ley-Null Ward
entries: The runebinder has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The runebinder makes two Arc-Bolt attacks, or it casts a spell and makes one Arc-Bolt attack.

action.name: Arc-Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) force damage.

action.name: Rune Snare (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The runebinder targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute by tightening, glowing bands. A {@condition restrained} target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While restrained this way, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Reactive Sigil
entries: When the runebinder is hit by an attack, it can impose disadvantage on the attack roll (potentially causing it to miss). If the attack still hits, the runebinder gains 10 temporary hit points.

monster.name: Heliox Arm Operator
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Integrated Harness
entries: While within 5 feet of a control station, the Heliox Arm Operator has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and it can't be forcibly moved more than 10 feet by nonmagical effects.

trait.name: Boarder Rejection Protocol
entries: The Heliox Arm Operator has advantage on opportunity attacks against creatures that are climbing, jumping, or boarding a vehicle or structure.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Heliox Arm Operator makes two Servo Slam attacks.

action.name: Servo Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet.

action.name: Clamp and Toss (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled this way, the Heliox Arm Operator can use a bonus action on its next turn to throw the target up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The thrown creature lands prone and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Dual-Forge Hammers
entries: The brute wields a Frost Hammer and a Cinder Hammer. Its hammer attacks count as magical.

trait.name: Overrun Frame
entries: The brute has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. In addition, it can move through the space of a Medium or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of its choice and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brute makes two hammer attacks, one with its Frost Hammer and one with its Cinder Hammer.

action.name: Frost Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Cinder Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Thermal Clash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The brute slams both hammers into the ground, releasing a violent shock of hot and cold. Each creature of the brute's choice within 15 feet must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Brutal Momentum
entries: If the sever-axe moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with an Axe attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sever-axe makes two Axe attacks.

action.name: Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d12 + 6}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Suppressive Hook (Recharge 6)
entries: The sever-axe makes one Axe attack. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Relay Crew
entries: If the technician uses its action to assist a creature stabilizing a portal, the remaining time needed to stabilize that portal is reduced by 1 round.

action.name: Signal Prod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Arc Spark
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Purge Crystal (1/Day)
entries: The technician activates a volatile crystal against one unattended object, document bundle, or console within 5 feet. The target begins burning or glassing over. A creature can use an action to stop the purge with a successful DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Intelligence (Arcana), or relevant tool check. If not stopped before the start of the technician's next turn, mundane documents are destroyed and a small device or console loses one recoverable clue.

bonus.name: Pack Component
entries: The technician packs or grabs one Tiny or Small relay component within 5 feet. Until the technician drops it, that component is no longer available as evidence unless the technician is stopped.

trait.name: Emergency Portal Stabilization
entries: At the start of an encounter, the handler can begin stabilizing an emergency portal if a relay focus is within 30 feet. Stabilizing the portal normally requires 3 rounds of concentration as if concentrating on a spell. Each allied Field Technician that uses its action to assist reduces the remaining time by 1 round. When stabilized, the portal remains open until the end of the handler's next turn, and the handler and willing creatures within 5 feet of it can escape. The process is interrupted while the handler is incapacitated.

trait.name: Mission Preservation
entries: The handler has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened while within 30 feet of a relay device.

action.name: Relay Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Command Static
entries: One creature the handler can see within 60 feet must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and can't take reactions until the start of the handler's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

action.name: Signal Snare (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The handler chooses a point it can see within 60 feet. Each creature of the handler's choice within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained by bands of hard-light signal until the end of the handler's next turn. A restrained creature can use its action to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Scrub Trace
entries: The handler targets one relay device, console, or document bundle within 30 feet. Until the start of the handler's next turn, checks to recover evidence from that target are made with disadvantage.

reaction.name: Redirect Pulse
entries: When the handler is hit by an attack while within 30 feet of a relay device, it adds 2 to its AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

trait.name: Extraction Discipline
entries: The escort can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action while within 60 feet of an allied Relay Handler.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The escort makes two Veil Saber attacks.

action.name: Veil Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Signal Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) force damage.

action.name: Veil Screen (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The escort creates a 15-foot-radius cloud of silver-black static centered on a point it can see within 30 feet. The area is heavily obscured until the end of the escort's next turn. Conclave creatures can see through the area as if it were lightly obscured.

reaction.name: Cover The Handler
entries: When an allied Relay Handler within 5 feet of the escort is hit by an attack, the escort can cause itself to be hit instead.

trait.name: Extraction Zeal
entries: While within 30 feet of a portal anchor, control station, or relay device, the cantor has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration.

spellcasting.name: Conclave Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cantor casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cantor makes two Null Lance attacks.

action.name: Null Lance
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) force damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Signal Fracture (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The cantor chooses a point it can see within 90 feet. Each enemy in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered there must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature also has disadvantage on the next concentration check it makes before the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Null Rebuke (2/Day)
entries: When a creature the cantor can see within 60 feet succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the cantor forces it to reroll the save and use the new result.

trait.name: Planar Footing
entries: The magister has advantage on saving throws against being pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or teleported against its will.

spellcasting.name: Conclave Spellcasting
headerEntries: The magister casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The magister makes two Rift Lance attacks.

action.name: Rift Lance
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) force damage. The magister can move the target 5 feet horizontally if it is Large or smaller.

action.name: Gravitic Fold (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each enemy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the magister can see within 90 feet must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage, is pulled up to 15 feet toward the center, and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't moved or knocked prone.

bonus.name: Vector Step
entries: The magister teleports itself or one willing allied creature it can see within 30 feet up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space the magister can see.

reaction.name: Deflect Trajectory
entries: When the magister or a creature within 10 feet of it is hit by a ranged attack, the magister adds 3 to the target's AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.
